ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast binary distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes and 40% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black geometric block occupying the central fluke base and radiating outward towards the mid-lobes; expansive white contiguous regions on the lateral lobes; sparse black mottling localized along the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern with multiple micro-peaks and valleys; includes a prominent secondary indentation on the right lobe trailing edge approximately two-thirds from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the leading edges; trailing edges follow a complex sigmoidal trajectory from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of dark pixel blobs on the upper interior region of the right lobe; isolated dark spots scattered on the distal white fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct near-vertical dark linear streaks on the left lobe; one prominent diagonal dark streak on the upper-right lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Jagged and irregular distal tip on the right fluke lobe, appearing more elongated and uneven compared to the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Handwritten alphanumeric annotations in the lower frame area, including ID '13542', location 'Cape Caution', and date '29 Aug 94'.
